title: Recovered memory of a virtual tour of Egypt

tellings.quote: the they took me the first thing I remembered was seeing Egypt why

plain: In 2007, a North Carolina man named Chris Bledsoe, who says he draws visits from UFOs, recovered a memory of beings taking him on what felt like a virtual tour of Egypt: the pyramids, the Sphinx, and a temple of the goddess Hathor. "The first thing I remembered was seeing Egypt," he says, and he still wonders why. He tells it as his own experience, and it would suggest the beings were trying to show him something about ancient history.
